summary_en: Tokai Rika executed a block acquisition of 2.6 million shares (2.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at 2,820 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on October 30, 2026, for a total outlay of 8.6 billion yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Matched Trade (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 29, 2026, Tokai Rika's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock using an off-hours matched trade mechanism (ToSTNeT-3). The company executed this block purchase on October 30, 2026, at the close-of-business price of 2,820 yen per share, acquiring 2.6 million shares—representing 2.9% of the 86.756 million issued shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock)—for an aggregate expenditure of 8.6 billion yen.

The acquisition was conducted as a single transaction during the ToSTNeT-3 trading window at 8:45 AM Tokyo Stock Exchange time, with the order valid only for that specific trading session. The company announced the acquisition results immediately following the close of this trading window. Market conditions could have resulted in partial or no execution, though the submission of sell orders matching the target share quantity indicates the trade was completed as intended.
